scenarios.name: Access server without DNS
steps: Given I visit the server at "http://10.0.5.14:8080/SSO-war/"
Then the page should load successfully

scenarios.name: Access server with DNS
steps: Given I visit the server at "Nom_de_domaine.xxx/SSO-war/"
Then the page should load successfully

scenarios.name: Access server with subdomain
steps: Given I visit the server at "SSO-war.nom_de_domaine.xxx"
Then the page should load successfully
Given the user is on the login page

scenarios.name: Page shows all login elements
steps: Then the page should have a login field
And the page should have a password field
And the page should have a connexion button
And the page should have a password recovery link

scenarios.name: Successful login with valid credentials
steps: When the user enters valid credentials
And clicks the connexion button
Then the user should be redirected to the dashboard

scenarios.name: Failed login with invalid credentials
steps: When the user enters invalid credentials
And clicks the connexion button
Then an error message should be displayed
Given the user is on the login page

scenarios.name: Navigate to password recovery
steps: When the user clicks the password recovery link
Then the password recovery page should be displayed

scenarios.name: Request password reset with valid email
steps: Given the user is on the password recovery page
When the user submits a valid email
Then a confirmation message should be shown
